articles.title: Toronto police officer charged with several firearm-related offences after Canada Border Services Agency probe
articles.summary: The Toronto Police Service (TPS) confirms that one of its officers has been charged with multiple firearm-related offences after a Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA) investigation. In a release, the CBSA alleges Nasser Gholami, 47, of Brampton, was the intended recipient of a parcel from the United States that contained two firearm suppressors. The parcel […]

articles.title: From the mouths of babes: 9-year-old interviews candidates to educate public about municipal election
articles.summary: Iya Thompson interviews candidates and breaks down the issues in Beaches-East York, through the eyes of a nine-year-old.

articles.title: Frances Nunziata not confirming reports she’s withdrawing from Toronto municipal election race
articles.summary: Long-time Toronto councillor Frances Nunziata is not confirming reports she is withdrawing from the municipal election race. CityNews had initially cited sources stating that the York South-Weston councillor would be dropping out on Friday. However, in a statement to CityNews, she said, “I continue to canvass. articles.title: Oshawa mayoral candidates focus on homelessness, downtown concerns at debate
articles.summary: Candidates shared plans to tackle homelessness and revitalize downtown Oshawa during Thursday's debate, hosted by the Greater Oshawa Chamber of Commerce at the Bond St. Event Centre.

articles.title: Ontario will officially begin removing Toronto bike lanes on Tuesday
articles.summary: Ontario will begin removing bike lanes from a stretch on Bloor Street W. in Etobicoke on Tuesday, the Ministry of Transportation says.

articles.title: Oshawa museum faces nearly $3K in city fines over homeless encampments on property
articles.summary: A charity that runs a museum in Oshawa has received nearly $3,000 in city fines for allowing "nuisance activity" on its property. It says it needs help, not penalties, to keep the museum safe from vandalism, trespassing and damage.
